fragen.text: I am a loving and empathetic person in relationships.
Romantic connections tend to come easily in my life.
I am ambitious and set myself clear career goals.
Other people respect my professional competence.
I consider myself skilled in financial matters.
Money and material security tend to come to me on their own.
I generally have a lot of energy and physical vitality.
I recover quickly from illness or strain.
I like being around people and feel comfortable in groups.
I make new acquaintances easily and keep in touch.
I consider myself a creative person.
I find unconventional solutions to problems spontaneously and intuitively.
Significant changes happen often in my life.
I am open to new things and adapt well to changing circumstances.
Spiritual or metaphysical topics are an important part of my life.
I often trust my intuition and inner voice.
